newsitem.title: USA: Airport Systems wins pacts worth $1.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Airport Systems wins pacts worth $1.1 mln.

text.p: Airport Systems International Inc said Tuesday it won two aircraft navigational assistance contracts worth a total of $1.1 million.

The company said it will install two instrument landing systems at Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport as part of one agreement and distance measuring and other equipment at an undisclosed location in the Pacific Rim as part of the other.
Airport Systems designs, makes and installs equipment and airfield signs to help in-flight navigation and ground movement of aircraft.
